description: This is a Java class that handles the command for rejecting a loan reschedule request within the Fineract loan management system. It is a service component that processes commands with specific entity and action annotations, delegating the rejection logic to a dedicated service.

classes.name: RejectLoanRescheduleRequestCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class responsible for handling command requests to reject loan reschedule proposals. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and is annotated to process commands of type RESCHEDULELOAN with the action REJECT.

methods.name: RejectLoanRescheduleRequestCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the LoanRescheduleRequestWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JsonCommand to reject a loan rescheduling request by delegating to the loanRescheduleRequestWritePlatformService.reject() method.
